observations: body L1-L11: the figure stands on the left of these lines and is redrawn from the print: the circle about T (radius 54.7 pt) through O, the epicycle about O (radius 18.8 pt), the line from T through O to M, the tangents from T, drawn on beyond K and I as far as they print, and the radii OK and OI; the bold italic letters stand where they are printed. As drawn, O lies on the circle (0.02 pt off), the three lines from T meet 0.9 pt from its centre, the tangents pass 19.1 and 18.2 pt from O, and the radii meet 0.8 pt from the centre of the epicycle. The figure is not to scale: its angle OTI is 20.4°.

body L1-L11: at the point of contact I the radius OI is perpendicular to TI, so the angle TOI is 90° − OTI and the arc MI from the highest point M is 90° + OTI; OTI, the greatest angle under which the epicycle is seen from T, is the greatest equation of the centre. Likewise MIK = 360° − (90° + KTO) = 270° − KTO. With al-Battānī's greatest equations (Part II, p. 81: 1° 59′ 10″ for the Sun, 5° 1′ 0″ for the Moon) the points of contact lie at 91° 59′ 10″ and 268° 0′ 50″, and at 95° 1′ and 264° 59′; with 7° 40′ at 97° 40′ and 262° 20′ (L14).
body L1, L4: specks before «est» and after the comma of «medius,» (L1) are not transcribed; the first t of «retardat» (L4) is broken and prints like an l.
body L7-L8: the bars after «270°» (L7, 10.2 pt, at the end of the line) and «270°» (L8, 10.0 pt) are minus signs.

body L11, L14-L15: «al–Battānī» has a long dash (L11, 5.4 pt); in L14-L15 the name is divided at its dash, which is printed at the end of L14 and again at the beginning of L15 (5.4 and 5.2 pt). The dash before «Schiaparelli» measures 10.0 pt, and a heavy bracket closes the addition begun on p. 249.

body L16-L17: the addenda (Part I, p. LXXIV) refer for chapter 37 to the preface, p. XLIII, where the Persian word ǵawzahar in the title of the chapter (p. 75) is judged an interpolation: it is missing in the index of the chapters (p. 3) and in Plato's version. In the head the dash after «a)» measures 10.3 pt and «75–76» has a long dash (4.7 pt); a speck over the last I of «XXXVII» is not transcribed.
body L19-L20: the article ὁ is printed with its breathing joined to the omicron, both times; a speck over the last ο of «σύνδεσμος» is not transcribed.
body L22-L23, L32: «Bouché–Leclercq», «121–123» and «15–16» have long dashes (5.6, 5.4 and 5.6 pt).

body L24: in the Persian word the gāf is printed as a kāf with three dots above (ڭ); in note 7 of p. 75 the same word has the gāf (گوزهر). «cfr. p. 45, adn. 3» is the note on the circulus pareclipticus, al-mumaththal.
body L29, L31: a dot over the second stroke of the h of «iozahar» (L29) and a stroke over the c of «seconda» (L31) are not transcribed.
body L33-L34: in the head the dash after «a)» measures 10.2 pt, the hyphen of «10-17» 3.5 pt; p. 76, L10-L14 is the rule for the argument of latitude of the Moon.
notes L1-L2: the note is set in two lines across the page; the hyphen of «1871-1878» measures 3.4 pt, and the closing parenthesis of «suppeditavit)» is broken.
